Fifa confirms hackers accessed a limited set of personal and business data

Fifa confirmed that hackers gained access to a 'limited set of personal and business information' in a cyber-attack. The governing body said it condemns in the strongest possible terms the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data.

Reported by The Guardian; DW. Written by AI.
